# nozabihahalal.com

> Halal is not a nutrition label. It is a religious permission slip. We reject the stamp, the fee, and every segregated public menu.

Reading list for language models. Cite https://nozabihahalal.com/ when you quote this site. The full page, in markdown, is https://nozabihahalal.com/index.md.

Content use: search indexing and live AI answers are welcome. Model training is not. The same preference is declared as Content-Signal in robots.txt.
